messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads up — PR #6125 bumps grpc -> 1.52. CI flagged a breaking test in staging. This is slated for today's 18:00 UTC deploy; we need 2x LGTM before the 17:50 UTC merge queue close or it waits for next window. Pinging reviewers who can help: @Ben, @Maria, @Samir. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6125
Maria Gomez: Does this change require anything from infra or is it purely library bump?
Ben Patel: Looks like a pure dependency bump. The failing test is an edge-case timing assert in client integration tests — I can push a tiny fix.
Tanvi Rao: @Release Bot what's the exact merge cutoff today? Need to confirm timing before we promise teams. :clock3: 
Release Bot: Release window today: deploy at 18:00 UTC. Merge queue closes at 17:50 UTC. Requirements to merge: 2x LGTM, CI green, and no unblocker labels.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Ben — if you can patch the test and push before 17:30 UTC, we should have time for 2nd review + CI.
Ben Patel: Pushed fix (commit 7c3a4f). The change is one-line in integration/test_client.py:
```
- assert resp.latency < 200
+ assert resp.latency <= 250  # accommodate minor env jitter
```
No behavior changes to runtime.
Maria Gomez: Running staging smoke now. Quick note: one flaky scenario still failing intermittently, attaching logs: https://logs.redwood/smoke/1832.
Samir Khan: FYI if this affects tail latency we should gate behind a canary route. If it's just test timing I'm fine reviewing.
Tanvi Rao: We still need two human LGTM's. @Samir can you take a look after Maria's smoke completes?
Samir Khan: I can review in ~10m. If Ben's commit doesn't touch infra I'm fine giving the second LGTM.
Ben Patel: No infra changes, only test assert.
Alex Chen: If we don't get 2x LGTM by 17:45 UTC I'm going to pull it out of the queue so we don't block the deploy. We can schedule a special patch in the next cycle.
Maria Gomez: Staging smoke passed except the transient timing case — Ben's change addresses it. I'm +1 and left a small comment about the assertion message.
Samir Khan: Reviewed, left a tiny nit about the comment format but not blocking. LGTM.
Tanvi Rao: LGTM from me as well (after Samir's nit).
Alex Chen: Great — CI green, 2x LGTM, queue bound satisfied. Merging now and will watch the canary. :rocket:
Release Bot: PR #6125 merged by Alex Chen at 17:56 UTC. Canary rollout started. Monitor: https://console.redwood/canary/6125
Alex Chen: I'll follow up in #eng-sre if we see any regressions. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :tada:
